source_fingerprint_method: scripts.package_app.native_provenance('universal')['source_fingerprint']; covers native, engine and packaging inputs, not documentation.

independent_ui_grade.scope: Independent read-only developer heuristic review of current production AppKit source, actual native CUA scene captures and interaction evidence; not a user study or universal certification.

native_visual_review.capture_method: Actual native CUA captures of production AppKit views with isolated preferences, disabled folder-rule fixtures and public sample inputs. No bitmap-cached render is used as native UI proof.
additional_compact_endpoints_observed: Finder Settings last action in light and dark
Puzzle Match, Actions, Rename, Output and Original sections
Activity final failure row and its complete Details action
Guide final startup and update instructions
Expanded Batch options and concurrency guidance
Save location jump revealing the complete destination card
native_visual_review.top_menu_proof_scope: Coordinator operated native menus; independent reviewer inspected the saved native accessibility transcript and production source. No top-menu image proof is claimed.
native_visual_review.real_quality_and_report_observed: Real six-category batch and a later WAV-to-MP3 quality change with a completed readable report; layout fixture outcomes are simulated and are not conversion evidence.

custom_quality_motion_repair.trigger: User reported an odd animation after the first final UI grade; applicable visual approval was reopened until the repaired source and rebuilt app were checked.
repair: Settle NSStackView visibility and layout immediately with implicit geometry animation disabled.
Cancel preceding clip-bounds motion and apply one immediate minimal reveal clamped to document bounds.
Fade only adjustment controls and estimate text using the shared native transition.
Keep current state immediate; use no completion callback that restores an older state.

limits: Scores are developer heuristic judgments, not a novice-user study or universal certification.
Manual VoiceOver and novice participants were not tested.
Physical logout/login was not performed; startup presentation used isolated events and preferences.
Older macOS appearance and physical Intel hardware or Intel engine installation were not tested.
Long-duration energy use, conversion-engine peak memory and animation frame-time distributions were not measured.
QA helpers and disabled fixtures do not establish final installed-package behavior.
Raw CUA captures and the local accessibility transcript remain private; only representative documentation images are referenced.
